items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: We’ve been part of great group tours as well. You know we’re going to be on an upcoming tour with a couple of other great bands, Andy Frasco and Dogs in a Pile where it’s co-headlining

ctx.x: In your business what does it mean to be the headliner?

I mean I guess if you’re just on your own a lot of the times we’ll do group tours or if there’s a tour of different bands you know. We’ve been lucky enough to headline our own tours in the sense that, you know it’s our show, we’ll bring along an opener or a local support, but it’s typically, it’s a lot of time to kind of fill and produce a show every © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

night and those headline tours are — you know it’s a lot of work like Ben just mentioned, it’s a new set list every night and when we return to the city from the last time we’ll bring up that set list and make sure we’re not repeating material. Because we’re also fans of music. We realize that a lot of fans of bands might only get a couple of chances to see a band they love. Maybe once a year, maybe once in their life. So we’ve been part of great group tours as well. You know we’re going to be on an upcoming tour…
